attr.title: Logical Journey of the Zoombinis
attr.desc: Broderbund's 1996 logic puzzle adventure. Guide the little blue Zoombinis through twelve puzzles of deduction and pattern-finding on their way to a new home, running on the zbtools decompilation.
attr.inst: Copy your Logical Journey of the Zoombinis Windows CD (original, Deluxe, 2001 rerelease, French or German edition) into ports/zoombinis/gamedata, as an .iso, a .bin/.cue or the files on the CD. The game installs itself from it on first launch.
